scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w @arena3q/api" "npm run dev -w @arena3q/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @arena3q/api && npm run build -w @arena3q/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @arena3q/api && npm run typecheck -w @arena3q/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @arena3q/api && vitest run
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:migrate -w @arena3q/api
